luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local net = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "networkmodule").getNet()
check(net.getHostname() ~= nil, "hostname")

check(net.sendComputer("self", "ping"), "sendComputer")
check(net.hasComputerMessage("self"), "hasComputerMessage")
check(net.receiveComputer("self").getContent() == "ping", "receiveComputer")
local stop = console.getTime() + 10000
local sent = false
while not sent and console.getTime() < stop do
  sent = net.sendEntity("wt", "hello")
  util.sleep(200)
end
check(sent, "sendEntity delivered")
print("PASS networking sender")

local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local net = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "networkmodule").getNet()
check(net.getHostname() ~= nil, "hostname")

local stop = console.getTime() + 15000
while not net.hasEntityMessage("wt") and console.getTime() < stop do util.sleep(100) end
local msg = net.receiveEntity("wt")
check(msg ~= nil and msg.getContent() == "hello", "receiveEntity")
check(msg.getTransport() == "entity", "transport")
print("PASS networking receiver")
